tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal chen rdo rje phur pa yi/ /rab gnas byin rlabs 'dod dgu'i char/ /lnga bdo'i mi mthun rgud tshogs me/ /zhi byed thugs rje'i rgya mtsho bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badzra ki la ya/ 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos dpal rdo rje phur pa'i rab gnas kyi rnam bzhag las sbyor ba ni rdo rje phur pa'i sa chog sta gon la dgos chas rnams dang / rab gnas don gnyis lhun grub sogs nas 'byung ba'i khrus stegs sbyong chas khrus chas rnams so/ /dngos gzhi ngag 'don gang yin 'dir bris na sa chog rgyas pa ni dpal sa skya'i gro bzhin sgrub mchod bzhin/ bsdus pa la dga' na sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bgegs skrod bar rgyun bzhin la/ de nas phur pa bcu/ e spha ra ṇas gdan bskyed sogs rgyun bzhin/ ma tha bhañtsa ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa bar/ phyag rgya'i gar 'chams zhes sogs dkyil 'khor bsdu mi dgos pas bskang ba mjug chog sogs 'phros rnams rgyun bzhin/ yang sa chog ma byas par sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis kyi sgo nas byed pa ltar na/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bdag bskyed kyi/ karma kro dhi shwa ri āḥbar rgyun bzhin/ de nas/ paṃ padma maṇḍal la/ pad ma'i gdan du sogs nas/ gser gyi sa gzhir gyur par rgyun bzhin bdag ni sems can nas/ bri bar brjod/ oṃ badzra kro dha sogs sta gon yongs rdzogs rgyun bzhin/ thig tshon byin rlabs bris zin nas/ thig tshon ye shes pa gshegs bsdu/ phur bkod rgyal chen tho 'dzugs bum pa 'bul ba/ lhag chad kha skong / dkyil 'khor gsol gdab rnams rgyun bzhin/ dngos gzhi'i sngon 'gro gtor ma nas phyi rol rjes kyi bzod gsol bar rgyun bzhin/ de nas khrus bum brgyad la/ las bum gyi chu ku shas gtor te/ oṃ badzra kro dha sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa rnams yangs shing rgya che ba/

zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa dkris pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang so so'i rdzas kyis yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gandha snā na pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ de bzhin thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ dri ma dhū ma la pha la bru hi lardza e ṣa dhi ma ṇi zhes par bsgyur/ rnam rgyal gzungs ring / oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li sogs bzlas la/ nang rdzas rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i so so'i bum pa rten gyi dri ma sbyong ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ sarba bighnan na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi sha mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ grihṇe daṃ ba lyāe de swāhā/ 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i rten rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i gdon bgegs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis shig oṃ sum bha ni/ sogs rgyun bzhin/ 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i rten rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i gdon bgegs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma lam brngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ changs bu lam brgyags kyi tshul du khyer la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig khro bo spyan 'dren gdan 'bul mchod bstod sogs rgyun bzhin/ na mo sogs nas chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i bka' bden pa dang / bden pa yang dag pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyi bar/ rgyun gyi liṅka'i dgug gzhug bden bdar bzhin/ deng 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa thams cad la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyong ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pas/ des tshim par gyis la zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig

gal te mi 'gro ba de dag thams cad la dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje ye shes kyi me 'bar ba 'dis/ khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ badzra kī li sogs dang / khro bcu'i sngags yongs rdzogs sam yang na bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags bzla/ bdag dang yon bdag gis gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa rnams snying khar yi ge kaṃ nag po'i rnam par gnas par sna sgor sdig pa rā can gyi rnam par thon nas mdun gyi til la thim pa de nyid g.yas su ye shes kyi mes bsreg cing g.yon du rgya mtsho'i chus bkrus par gyur/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmin ku ru swāhā/ bdag dang yon bdag gis gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig ji ltar bltams pa༞ 'di ni khrus mchog༞ de bzhin gshegs pa/ sogs rgyun bzhin sngags bcas/ de dag sogs rgyun bzhin/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / /'gro ba'i lus sems sdug bsngal bsal slad du/ /chu gtsang sman spos 'dag chal 'di bkrus pas/ /bdag cag dam pa'i sku mchog thob par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ni swāhā/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gandha snā na pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ sku phyi dang byug rdzas gsum sngags bcas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yi/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bya'o/ /tri ma dhu/ sku phyis byug rdzas sogs/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /gtong ba dri yis legs bgos chu/

/khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ /ma la sku phyis sogs/ 'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu/ /khrims 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /tshul khrims dri yis legs bgos chu/ /khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ /pha la sku phyis sogs/ 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /khong khro'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /bzod pa dri yis legs bgos chu/ /khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ /bru hi sku phyis sogs/ 'di ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu/ /le lo'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /brtson 'grus dri yis legs bgos chu/ /khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ /lardza sku phyis sogs/ 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu/ /rnam g.yeng dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /bsam gtan dri yis legs bgos chu/ /khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ /e ṣa dhi/ sku phyis sogs/ 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu/ /shes 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /shes rab dri yis legs bgos chu/ /khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ṇi snā na pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ sku phyis dgos/ byug rdzas mi dgos/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas/ /bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni/ /gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing / /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas/ /dri ma rnam drug sbyongs mdzad pa/ /rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa'i/ /khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'/ /dri ma rnam drug dag pa yis/ /yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du/ /dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /gang la ser sna dang / bzang khrus sku phyis bcas rgyun bzhin/ bcom rdung rnga rol gsum brdegs len can/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta sogs/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta sogs/ brdung 'dur shur gang rung gis/ lha khang mi dmigs stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las lha khang rnams/

pad nyi zla bar lha brgya byin sogs 'og mchod rten bzhin/ rten rnams mi dmigs stong par gyur/ /stong pa'i ngang las bla ma dang / /yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems/ /chos skyong nor lha'i sku rnams ni/ /pad nyi zla bar dbang phyug dang / /u ma bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ mtshan las/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ nas/ ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /bar bdag bskyed ni/ yum chen 'khor lo nas/ yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud pas bzhugs/ bar yang de bzhin/ gsum brdeg lan can bsdus pa/ dkyil 'khor sna tshogs mi dmigs te/ /stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng / /hūm̐ byung sna tshogs rdo rje'i lter/ /hūm̐ mtshan las 'phros rdo rje'i sa/ /rwa gur bla bre me 'od can/ /bsrung 'khor de nang gzhal yas khang / /gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bcas/ /rang rang phyogs mdog rtsig rim can/ /thog phub rim gsum dang bcas pa'i/ /phyi rol dur khrod brgyad bskor dang / /dur khrod me rnams 'od phreng sogs/ /so so'i mtshan nyid ldan nang du/ /lha grangs dang mthun pad nyi'i zlar/ /dbang phyug pho mo bsnol gdan la/ /hūm̐ las sogs gong bzhin mthar gsum brdeg len can bsdus/ pusti gzungs dang yig 'bru rnams/ /pad nyi zla bar chu yi lha/ /pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /āḥlas padma āḥs mtshan pa/ /bcom ldan padma kī la ya/ /dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /g.yas sngo g.yon dkar dbus dmar zhal/ /rdo rje rtse dgu pad ma dang / /me dpung 'bar ba nas/ zhabs bzhi'i/ bar 'dra/ chu lha pho mo'i mgo bo dang / /nu ma brdzis shing khyung gshog can/ /yum chen padma kro dhi dmar/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas padma/ /g.yon pa'i thod khrag nas/ 'khyud pas bzhugs bar gong bzhin/ mthar gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa/ satstsha la sogs mchod rten rnams/ /pad nyi zla bar lha brgya byin/ /pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/

/oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ mtshan las/ /bcom ldan buddha kī la ya/ /smug nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus smug zhal/ /rdo rje rtse dgu 'khor lo dang / /me sogs padma kī la ya/ /dang 'dra zhing / zhabs bzhi'i bar yang 'dra/ brgya byin pho mo'i sogs 'dra'o/ /yum chen buddha shwa ri smug /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo/ /sogs 'dra'o/ /de nyid 'od du zhu ba las/ /mchod rten so so'i mtshan nyid can/ /bum nang pad nyi zla gdan lnga'i/ /dbus su brgya byin pho mo dang / /shar du dbang phyug pho mo dang / /lhor ni gshin rje pho mo dang / /nub tu chu lha pho mo dang / /byang du gnod sbyin pho mo rnams/ /bsnol steng dbus su oṃ 'khor las/ /bcom ldan buddha sogs/ shar du rdo rje hūm̐ mtshan las/ /bcom ldan badzra/ sogs gtso bo yab yum bzhin/ lhor ni rin chen swā mtshan las/ /bcom ldan ratna kī la ya/ /ser nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ser zhal/ /rdo rje rtse dgu rin chen dang / /me sogs 'gre/ gshin rje pho mo sogs 'gre/ yum chen ratna kro ddhi ser/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rin chen/ /g.yon pa'i sogs 'gre/ gnod sbyin pho mo sogs 'gre/ nub tu padma āḥs mtshan las/ /bcom ldan padma kī la ya/ /sogs pusti bskyed skabs bzhin/ byang du sna tshogs rdo rje hā/ /bcom ldan karma kī la ya/ /ljang nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ljang zhal/ /rdo rje rtse dgu rgya gram dang / /me sogs 'gre/ yum chen karma kro ddhi ljang / /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rgya gram/ /g.yon pas thod khrag sogs 'gre/ mthar gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa/ gur zhal la sogs chos srung sku/ /thun mong min rnams pad nyi zlar/ /dbang phyug u ma bsnol steng du/ /hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ mtshan las/ /bcom ldan badzra/ sogs 'gre gong bzhin/ mthar gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa/

gtsug lag khang 'di pad nyi zlar/ /brgya byin pho mo bsnol steng du/ /oṃ las 'khor lo/ sogs gong gi mchod rten bskyed chog bzhin la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ de nyid 'od du zhu ba las/ /gtsug lag khang nang pad nyi zla'i/ /gdan lnga'i dbus bu lha pho mo/ /shar du/ sogs rigs lnga'i gdan dang bskyed chog gong gi mchod rten bzhin/ mthar gsum brdeg len can bsdus pas/ de yi byang shar gur zhal/ sogs chos srung rnams dang / shar lho'i char/ rnam sras dzaṃ lha rig byed ma/ /tshogs bdag 'dod rgyal dbyu gu spun/ /de sogs nor lha'i tshogs bzhugs par/ /sangs rgyas byang sems bsam yas kyis/ /bskor ba'i rten rnams thams cad kyi/ /gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan/ /rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las/ /'od 'phros 'og min zhing mchog nas/ /rang 'dra'i ye shes spyan drangs gyur/ /gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa/ de nas/ sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs bcas/ sgeg cing dpa' dang mi sdug tshul ston cing / /dgod dang gshe dang 'jigs su rung ba dang / /snying rje rngams dang zhi ba la sogs pa/ /gar dgus rol mdzad dpal chen rigs lnga'i lha/ /glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rjes 'dir gshegs nas/ /ki lā ya yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /gsum brdeg len can chems brdung / oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ chems brdung rdzogs nas sbram sbram gcig byas/ gnyis byas/ gsum byas/ gcig gnyis gsum byas/ gcig gnyis gsum byas/ gcig zhes rol mo bzhag rnga phyir brdung bsgral mchod 'tshams dbyangs kyis/ gdug cing sdang sems zhes sogs sgrub thabs kyi dbu bzhin rol mo rgyun bzhin gyi mthar/ chems brdung / drag brdung / kī la ya/ dang khro bcu'i sngags/ slob dpon gyis dril gsil yungs dkar brab pas phyir 'brang bskrad/ gsum brdeg len can/ rnga nang brdung / yang dag don dang / bde bar gshegs pa'i dbyangs rol rgyun bzhin/

bde bar gshegs pa khyed ci 'dra/ /de 'dra kho nar rten rnams gyur/ /spyod pa rmad byung sogs nas/ bdag gi bsam pa 'grub gyur cig /bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ oṃ badzra sogs gong bzhin/ oṃ badzra yakṣi ṇi sogs nas ma ra ṇi hūm̐ hoḥ sbram gcig gnyis gsum byas zhes sogs gsum brdeg len can rnga rol bzhag la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ phreng 'khor sogs ci 'grub/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon las/ /'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i rgyal rgyal sras/ /bsam gyis mi khyab spyan drangs gyur/ /bcom rdung bcom rol gong bzhin yang dag don du dbyangs rol bcas/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /dga' ldan du ni gnas pa ni/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar/ /de bzhin gzugs brnyan lhan cig tu/ /'di ru mgon po rtag bzhugs nas/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang / /sbyin pa'i bdag po'i don slad du/ /bdag gi 'byor pa nyid kyis ni/ /ci 'byor pa yi mchod pa rnams/ /me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /rjes su brtse bar dgongs su gsol/ /kun gyis 'di la byin brlabs shing / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs par rigs/ /'dur gdangs kyi mthar gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa bcas/ de 'dra tshar gnyis kyi rjes mar chems brdungs/ sbram gcig gnyis zhes rol mo bzhag bde bar gshegs pa khyed ci 'dra/ /nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ grangs mang brjod pa'i bar gong bzhin/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /sogs nas/ karma kro dhi shwa ri aḥ bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ rten rnams la rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan/ mchod pa byin rlabs sogs sta gon mjug chog bzhin phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ hūm̐ snang stong rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings/ /chos dbyings ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal rnam par snang mdzad la/ /gzung 'dzin rdo rje brtan pa'i sa/ /me long ye shes rdo rje'i sku/

/bdud 'dul chen po'i phyag rgya can/ /phyag mtshan mi bskyod rdo rje la/ /rin chen rdo rje 'bar ba'i me/ /mnyam nyid ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /mchog sbyin chen po'i phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal rin chen 'byung ldan la/ /'dod chags rdo rje chos kyi chu/ /kun rtog ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /ting 'dzin chen po'i phyag rgya can/ /phyag mtshan snang ba mtha' yas la/ /phrag dog rdo rje bskyod pa'i rlung / /bya grub ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /skyabs sbyin chen po'i phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal don yod grub pa la'o/ /zhes dang / 'gro ba rgyud lnga 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor gyis gzir 'gro gzigs nas/ /thugs rjes sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor 'joms mdzad pa/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ /sems can khams na bzhugs shing spyod gyur kyang / /chags pas ma gos padma ltar dag pa/ /'dod chags dag pa'i bdag nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sems can bkren pa chos kyis phongs gyur pa/ /ma rig 'thib po'i nang du song ba rnams/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun dag gis tshim mdzad pa/ /ye shes sgron me khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa la/ /thugs rjes thabs dang shes rab grur bzhag nas/ /zhi ba rin chen mchog gling skye mdzad pa/ /kun gyi ded dpon khyod la kun nas 'dud/ /sems can las kyi chu bor gru nub rnams/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i zam pas sgrol mdzad cing / /'phags lam yan lag brgyad la sbyor mdzad pa/ /gsung gi mnga' bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /shlau gcig sogs gdangs dang bcas pas bstod la/ gtor bsngo bskang ba srid zhi dpal 'byor ma rdzogs bar/ slob dpon gyis spos rdor dril bcas/ rigs lnga'i phur bu bcom ldan 'das/ /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid spyan dbye na/

/kun gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag gi /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /yo byad ci 'byor pa dag gis/ /rab gnas gnang bar bgyid par 'tshal/ /tshogs pa thams cad rab gnas pa/ /kun gyis byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum spos bzhag dril bu rgyun dkrol rdo rje snying ga dang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du dkon mchog gsum gyi rten rab tu gnas par bgyid par 'tshal na/ bde bar gshegs pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams sogs nangs par byon zhing rten byin gyis brlabs te bdag la dngos grub kyi mchog stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ sgeg phreng sogs/ rang byung / sogs sta gon mjug bzhin/ snang stong ma dang 'gro rgyud mas bstod/ yig brgya gsum sogs ci 'grub/ ma 'byor ba dang / sogs shlau ka gcig khu tshur gnyis kyi mthe'u chung sbrel/ mdzub mo brkyang ste rtse sprad pa gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor bzlog te/ hūm̐ badzra u tiṣṭha/ rten gyi ye shes pa thams cad sang spyan ma drangs kyi bar du mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod la gong bzhin sngags brjod/ bstod pa rnams bya'o/ /'on kyang lha sa'i jo bo rin po che sogs rten byin can rnams la ni dmigs pa 'di mi bya zhing / 'og tu bshad pa'i zhal khebs kyang mi bya/ rten gsar pa rnams la 'di bzhin bya'o/ /dar la sogs pa'i na bza' ser pos/ rten rnams mi mngon par dgab/ bris sku'i zhal khebs rnams kyang dgab la/ oṃ badzra wasatrā ya āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes dang / las thams cad pa'i sngags/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta/ sogs lan gsum brjod pas bsrung / sgrub mchod mjug chog rgyun bzhin te rab gnas kyi sta gon yongs rdzogs bstan zin to//

༈ /rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi'i chas rnams don gnyis lhun grub sogs nas 'byung ba ltar dang / dgra bgegs kyi liṅga phur pa gsum/ ral yungs tho ba rnams bshams/ rdzas la dgos pa'i dar dpyangs/ rdo rje rtse dgu/ thod pa rnams bshams/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bdag 'jug rdzogs bar rgyun bzhin/ khrus bum sgrub pa nas/ khrus rdzogs/ bar gong bzhin/ oṃ sarba bidyā swāhā/ oṃ ye dharmā he du pra bha wā he tunte ṣanta thā ga te hya ba data/ te ṣañtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ ba di ma hā shrā ma ṇa/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/ /yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /thams cad du yang sdom pa legs/ /gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rigs pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das te rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dgos pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa chos thams cad thugs su chud pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te shākya mu ne ye ta thā ga tā ya ar ha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ye/ tadya thā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swāhā/ oṃ badzra kī li sogs/ gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das kyi byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang yang dag par ldan pa stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum dang / thugs rje chen po la sogs pa mdor na slob pa dang / mi slob pa'i sangs rgyas su byed pa'i chos rnams dang yang dag par ldan pa/ de'i skyon gyis nyes pa thams cad dang bral zhing bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi chos tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/

/rol mo sogs gong bzhin/ gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das kyi bla na med pa'i tshul khrims la sogs pa'i phung po lnga dang yang dag par ldan pa dang / cho 'phrul gsum dang / ting nge 'dzin gsum dang / bslab pa gsum dang / tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / yang dag par ldan pas de'i yang dag pa phyin ci ma log pa'i ye shes dang / shes bya'i yul thams cad la mnga' brnyes pas nyon mongs pa ma lus pa la sogs pa rnams spangs pa dang / bdud bzhi las rab tu rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /rol mo sogs gong bzhin/ gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das kyis pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa dang / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yang dag par bsags pa dang / skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis yang dag par brgyan pa dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus yang dag par mdzes pa dang / skyes bu chen po'i sku lta bas chog mi shes pa dang / mthong na mi mthun pa med pa ste/ de'i gzugs kyi sku'i 'byor pa mthar thug pas 'gro ba ma lus pa'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa'i/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /rol mo sogs gong bzhin/ de 'dra tshar gsum/ de nas tsog pu thal sbyar 'bru bcas kyi/ ngo mtshar chen po grangs med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /de dag thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du dkon mchog gsum gyi rten rab tu gnas par bgyi ba de'i mthus/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi dbugs dbyung ngo / /'khor ba'i gcong rong chen po las bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /phas kyi rgol ba bdud dang log 'dren thams cad pham par bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa'i rtogs pa thams cad bsal bar bgyi'o/

/sems can thams cad kyi nga rgyal gyi ri bo bsnyil bar bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi skye ba'i ljon shing rtsad nas gcod do/ /'chi bdag gi nyi ma phye mar brlag go /ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal bar bgyi'o/ /ma dad pa dang phyir rgol ba dag dang / lta ba phyin ci log pa dag yang dag pa'i lta ba la gzud cing dad par bsgyur ro/ /las kyi chu bo bzlog par bgyi'o/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho bskam par bgyi'o/ /chos kyi sgron me sbar bar bgyi'o/ /byang chub kyi lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /bzod pa dang nges pa la gzud do/ /bsam gtan gyi bde ba la rtser stsal to/ /'dod chags kyi me phung gzhil bar bgyi'o/ /zhe sdang gi mtshon rtse rnon po gzhom par bgyi'o/ /bden pa gzud do/ /phrag dog gi 'tshubs ma zhi bar bgyi'o/ /ser sna'i mdud pa dgrol bar bgyi'o/ /sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bgyi'o/ /'jigs pa ma mchis pa dang / bde ba chen po'i grong khyer du 'jug cing gnas par bgyi'o/ /de bas na bdag la las kyi dngos grub kyi mchog stsal zhing gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ 'bru gzung ba rten la gtor nas gral la 'khod/ rten bskyed nas ye shes pa spyan 'dren gyi bar gong bzhin la/ rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' dang / /sta gon rten gyi ye shes pa/ /nam mkhar bzhugs la sangs rgyas dang / /byang sems bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /bskor ba gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur/ /zhes brjod/ gzhan 'dra bas/ tsitta badzra swā bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ bar 'dra/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha khro bo rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ slob dpon dam pa dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i dbang bskur rnams/ /sems can kun la phan bdag phyir/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang stsol cig /lan gsum rten dang dbang rdzas la las bum gyi chu kha rgyan gyis gtor la/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ tas bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/

rten dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ḥ 'di rnams mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo kho na yin/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pa las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ oṃ badzra a ha ra li hūm̐/ puṣpaṃ/ dhu paṃ/ ā lo ke gandhai/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra u da pha la hūm̐/ biṣpu ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang / dril bu gsil zhing / mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che/ /rdo rje'i thugs ni bla na med/ /skye med spros bral ngo bo nyid/ /mi bskyod pa la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mchod cing bstod de 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ che ba'i yon tan kun rdzogs shing / /byang chub sems rab chus gang ba/ /rnam par dag pa'i bum pa 'dis/ /bu khyod la ni dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badzra bha waḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ badzra akṣo bhyaḥ badzra a ha ra li hūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dya/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ u da pha la biṣpu ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ bsangs sbyangs gong bzhin/ rten dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang /

raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ swa las rin po che swas mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sogs dang / gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rin po che dang dril bu sogs/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren la/ thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnam par/ sogs dril gsil gyi bar bya/ lta ba ngan pa 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /rin chen rgyal po yon tan gtso/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /rin chen 'byung ldan phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du gyur/ gsol ba btab la dbu rgyan lag tu thogs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi rgyan/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi/ /rin po che'i dbu brgyan dang / /dar dpyangs dag gis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ ratna mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa swa/ badzra rā ga ta badzra sha li hoḥ bum chu gtor la/ oṃ badzri sogs nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ ratna sambha wa badzra a ha ra li/ sogs rol chen dang / bsangs sbyangs/ rten dang dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du āḥlas padma as mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sogs/ 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis padma dang dril bu 'dzin pa sogs dang / 'od dpag med kyi rnam par nas/ dril gsil gyi bar dang / rdo rje gsung ni dpag med pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung mchog dpal/ /rdo rje'i gsung ni kun 'byung ba/ /rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sogs/ dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ gsol ba btab la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /don ni byang chub sems yin pas/ /gnyis med don gyi ngo bo nyid/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ chu dbang / 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ a mṛ ta bha wā hrīḥ sogs rol chen dang / bsangs sbyangs/ rten dang dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las gdan bskyed/

ha las ral gri has mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas/ sogs/ don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ sogs dang / don yod grub pa'i rnam par nas/ dril gsil gyi bar dang / rdo rje las rab kun gyi gtso/ /sems can kun gyi don grub pa/ /bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /las kyi gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sogs/ dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ gsol ba btab la/ 'di ni shes rab kun gyi dngos/ /byang chub bsgom phyir rang bzhin te/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gro ba/ /khyod la de ring 'dis dbang bskur/ /oṃ badzra ghanḍe a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ chu dbang / don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ a mo gha siddhi/ sogs rol chen dang bsangs sbyangs/ rten dang dbang rdzas rdo rje dang dril bu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ gdan bskyed/ oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sogs/ rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa sogs dang / rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam par/ dril gsil gyi bar dang / rdo rje'i sku ni dga' chen po/ /thams cad zhi ba'i mchog nyid gsal/ /rang gi ngang gi 'od gsal mchog /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sogs/ dbang rdzas rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ gsol ba btab la/ rdor dril lag gnyis kas bzung zhing 'khrol la/ 'di ni sangs rgyas dngos yin te/ /rab tu bsngags pa gsang ba'i ming / /rang gi gsang mtshan brjod/ mi bskyod rdo rje zhes bya ba/ /ces pa lta bu/ de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badzra satwa satwaṃ badzra na ma a bhi ṣe ka kye dpal rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /bum chu gtor/ dbang bskur/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ bai ro tsa ni/ sogs rol chen dang / bsangs sbyangs/ las bum gyi chu mi 'thor/ stong pa'i ngang las padma nyi ma dbang phyug pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la/

rten rnams hūm̐ las rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar ba/ dbus mthing nag phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse dgu pa dang rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ g.yon dang po gnyis kyis me dpung 'bar ba dang rtse gsum bsnams pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis ri rab kyi phur bu bsgril zhing dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa'i pang na yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas 'khor lo g.yon thod khrag rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ rdo rje rtse dgu pa dang thod pa a las ka pā la bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ shes rab pad ma'i snod yin te/ /thabs mchog ye shes rtse dgu pa/ /thabs dang shes rab phyag mtshan 'dis/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pra dzñā u pa ta ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ thabs mchog ye shes rdo rje dang / /shes rab chos kyi dril bu bzung / /phyag rgya chen pos byin brlabs te/ /dam tshig gsum po rab tu brten/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yis/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po ru/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān bandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ byang chub sems kyi rdo rje 'di/ /sems kyi sdug bsngal rnams 'joms te/ /gsang ba'i gnas ni dam pas na/ /de ring khyod la dbab par bya/ /zhes gnang bar bsams la/ nang mchod nas lce thog tu bzhag ste/ a ho ma hā su kha/ sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis kyang / /shes rab 'di la brten nas bsgrubs/ /rigs kyi bu mchog khyod kyis kyang /

/shes rab spang du mi rung ste/ /ye shes skye ba'i rgyu yin pas/ /khyod kyis 'dod chags ma spangs shig /ji ltar snang ba 'di dag kun/ /skad cig gcig la dmigs med pa/ /brjod pa'i tha snyad kun dang bral/ /rang byung ye shes zhes brjod do/ /rten rnams la so so'i rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan/ mchod pa byin rlabs mchod bstod rnams sta gon bzhin/ rdo rje spyan ma'i phyag rgyas bzung la/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang / /gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas/ /nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ tsakṣu tsakṣu sa manta tsakṣu bi sho dha ni swāhā/ ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing / sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces pa lan gsum brjod/ sgeg phreng rang byung snang stong 'gro rgyud rnams/ /gong bzhin/ slob dpon thams cad bzhengs te mgrin gcig tu/ ye dharmā/ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i me tog bzung la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol lo/ /bye brag tu sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di dag la sa dang / chu dang / me dang / rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du sems can thams cad kyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas pas gtso byas sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod cing sna tshogs rol mo dang / rten la me tog gis char dbab/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ya swāhā/ yang yang brjod/

rten 'brel snying po bzlas so/ /de ltar lan gsum du byas la/ de nas zhal bsgyur ba ni/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dang / /byang sems chos skyong nor lha'i sku/ /rdo rje gzhon nur bskyed pa rnams/ /'od zhu so so'i rnam par gyur/ /gur zhal la sogs chos skyong sku/ /badzra kī lar bskyed pa rnams/ /'od zhu so so'i rnam par gyur/ /pusti la sogs yig 'bru rnams/ /padma ki lar bskyed pa rnams/ /lung rtogs bdag nyid chos dkon mchog /glegs bam sogs kyi rnam par gyur/ /mchod pa byin rlabs gong bzhin/ rdo rje sgeg mo sogs/ rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi/ /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ /rigs lnga sogs nas/ 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /na maḥsogs nas khā hi'i bar/ byang chub nas/ pra ti gṛhṇa khā hi bar/ dgug gzhug nas/ kha tham kha tham kha tham/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ badzra yakṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bar/ he ru ka nas/ bla med ma sngags bcas rdzogs bar/ hūm̐ gru gsum/ nas/ khro bcu'i dbyings nas 'gyed/ bar rnams sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin/ sku mdog rnam lnga'i nyon mongs dug lnga sbyong / /zhal gsum sku gsum rnam dag ngo bor ston/ /skyabs 'gro༞ /nyon mongs༞ /phyag mtshan lnga yis ye shes dang ldan/ /lhag ma'i phyag mtshan sa dgu'i rtog pa dang / /'khor ba'i bag chags dug gsum nyon mongs dang / /dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod pa'i dag pa can/ /glang chen nas/ tshur byon mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ /thugs rje che dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /bar sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin/ bhyoḥ de dang gnyis med sbyor ba'i yum mchog ni/ /badzra buddha ratna padma dang / /karma kro ti shwa ri gsang ba'i yum/ /baiḍūr sngon po mchong dang gser 'od 'bar/ /padma rā ga margad mdangs 'phrog ma/ /khro gnyer rab gtsigs ral pa mo dang nas/ sbrul zhags kyi/ bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ kha dog lnga ldan sku la mdzes par brgyan/

/zhing chen nas/ 'dril ma/ bar yang sgrub thabs bzhin/ rang rtags phyag mtshan 'bar ba g.yas na thogs/ /thod rlon/ sogs 'dra/ kro ti shwa ri rnam lnga dpal gyi yum/ /rdo rje me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du/ /dregs pa rnam lnga brdzis pa'i gdan steng na/ /gzir zhing nas/ mngon sum grub pa'i las mdzod da tshur byon/ /bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ dbyangs rol bcas/ rdzogs mtshams su gsum brdeg len can chems brdung rkang dung sogs 'dod chags khros pa'i mjug bzhin byas la rnga rol bzhag sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i sku ni rdo rje'i sku/ /mdzes shing lta bas chog mi shes/ /bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan ldan/ /bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i gsung ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /'gag med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan/ /mu stegs log lta 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma'i gsung la༞ /bla ma'i thugs ni nam mkha' 'dra/ /bde gsal mi rtog ngang tshul can/ /rnam thar gsum la legs gnas pa'i/ /bla ma'i thugs la༞ /bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /kun gyi byed po bla ma yin/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang / /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pas 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan song las grol zhing / /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa'i/ /zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sna tshogs padma zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /sna tshogs rin chen khams las grub pa yis/ /sprul pa'i mchod rten sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes/ /chos sku'i rang bzhin can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /steng dang 'og dang bar dag dang / /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su yang / /sku bcas sku ni med pa yi/

/mchod rten rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snang stong 'gro rgyud gnyis gong ma rnams bzhin/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid can/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad/ /yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pa/ /dri med mi g.yo mnyam nyid dam pa'i chos mchog can/ yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de/ /dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bskrun du yod ma yin/ /dngos grub mtha' yas dpag med dpe dang bral ba rnams/ /sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol/ /rtag tu dri ma med pa thugs rje'i shugs las byung / /smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can/ /'gro ba'i don sgrub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang / /tshad med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yi/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur kyang / /khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog rnams stsol mdzad pa'i/ /thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag par yang mi 'gyur/ /e ma ho shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan/ /mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang nas go 'phang mchog brnyes pa/ /khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub stsol mdzad pa/ /mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pas/ /dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yang dag yon tan rgya chen te/ /lan cig tsam zhig brjod pas kyang / /sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhis legs par brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /oṃ badzra pu re khed āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung gyur pa'i/ /spos mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku/ /gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/

/'dod chags 'bar ba de dag byugs par bgyi/ /oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim reg na bde/ /srab 'jam yang mdzes lha las byung ba yi/ /na bza' mchog 'di rdo rje'i sku la 'bul/ /bgres pa med pa rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ badzra wasatra sya āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ dri med mtshan la sgrib gsal mi mnga' yang / /dad pas ngur smrig rgyal mtshan phul ba yis/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas brtul zhugs mchog la spyod par shog /oṃ badzra wasatra ye āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin rgyan ldan phyir/ /rgyan gzhan dag gis brgyan par mi 'tshal yang / /rin chen rgyan mchog phul bas 'gro kun gyi/ /mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku lus thob par shog /oṃ badzra a laṅka ra wa pu ṣa ṇi āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ rgyal ba zag med 'byor la mnga' bsgyur yang / /'gro ba'i don du 'dod yon rnam lnga yi/ /mchod pas mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi/ /bsod rnams mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ badzra sa manta bha dra pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag ni/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus la/ /bshams shing yid gyis sprul te phul ba yis/ /'gro ba mi zad gter la longs spyod shog /oṃ badzra sapta ratna pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ rgyal ba mgon po dpal gyis lham mer bzhugs/ /bsod nams ye shes sku lnga brnyes pa la/ /lnga phrag lnga ldan snying po dam pa 'bul/ /'gro bas bde gshegs snying po thob par shog /oṃ badzra pañtsa bi ma la pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ brtse ba'i khor yug snyan pa'i ba dan dang / /ting 'dzin bla bre spobs pa'i 'od gsal ba/ /mchog rkyen 'os pa'i nyer mkho 'di dag 'bul/ /skye bos rnam dag ye shes thob par shog /oṃ badzra ma hā pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ rgyal ba'i dbu skra mthon mthing skyon bral yang / /gzhan don bsgrub phyir khyim pa'i rtags spangs phyir/

/dad pas gser gyi 'dreg gcod phul ba yis/ /'gro kun sdug bsngal kun las grol bar shog /oṃ badzra ka tsa mu le āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zangs mdog ltar mdzes yid 'ong skyon bral yang / /bdag cag dad pas phyag dang zhabs rnams kyis/ /sor mo'i 'dreg gcod phul bas 'gro kun gyi/ /sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang po thob par shog /oṃ badzra nā gatstshe da dzi na āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ dbu skra rin chen lcang lo ma dkrugs shing / /mdzes shing lta bas mi ngom skyon bral yang / /bdag blo sbyangs phyir rkyen dang 'tshams pa 'di/ /phul bas 'gro kun dug gsum bral bar shog /oṃ badzra ba la sho dha ya āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ dri 'dzin rnam dag tshul khrims las 'khrungs pa/ /dge ba bsgrub phyir skyon las nges grol yang / /mos pas 'dzin byed dam pa phul ba yis/ /'gro bas bla med byang chub thob par shog /oṃ badzra ro ma dha ra āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ dkar la thags bzang bzhi bcu tshang ba'i tshems/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos la mnga' bsgyur yang / /bdag cag dad pas tshems shing dbul lags kyi/ /'gro bas sangs rgyas gsung dbyangs thob par shog /oṃ badzra danta sho dha ya āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ snyan bsrings mi mnga' kun tu gsal bar ldan/ /thub pa'i sgra 'dzin ngo bos dag na yang / /dag byed 'di ni bdag gis 'bul lags kyi/ /skye bos rtag tu dam chos thob par shog /oṃ badzra karna sho dha ya āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ sems can thams cad shes pa bcu dang ldan par gyur cig bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa dam pa'i chos yun ring du mi nub cing gnas par gyur cig sems can thams cad lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas kun tu bzang po'i smon lam la 'jug par gyur cig oṃ pra marda nā ya swāhā/ sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum thob par gyur cig rnam par thar pa brgyad thob par gyur cig

ye shes lnga dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ pa ti ka laṃ pa ya swāhā/ sems can thams cad dus thams cad du dar gyi cod paṇa dang lhab lhub la sogs pa mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur gyi rnam pa mang pos/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dang / de dag gis mchod rten dang / sku gzugs dang gsung rab la sogs pa dag la mchod pa byed par gyur cig oṃ pa taṃ ke swāhā/ sems can thams cad chos kyi grags pa'i snyan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob par gyur cig oṃ kun bhi ra dhwa dza ya swāhā/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba mi 'dzin mi gtong bas bdud bzhi las rgyal zhing chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig oṃ bra ma ṇā ya swāhā/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i skyabs dang ldan zhing chos kyi rgyal po chen por gyur cig ratna ma la traṃ/ na mastai ya dhi/ a nu ga ta pra tiṣṭha ta puṣpe ke tu ra dza ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddha ya tadya thā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ sems can thams cad mtshan dang dpe byad dang ldan te/ sku lta bas chog mi shes pa thob par gyur cig oṃ puṇyā dha ri dza ye swāhā/ sems can thams cad kyi gdan gyi khyad par stobs bcu dang ldan pa glang po che'i gdan dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ldan pa seng ge'i gdan dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang ldan pa rta'i gdan dang / dbang bcu dang ldan pa rma bya'i gdan dang / thams cad du thogs pa med pa stobs kyi shugs dang ldan pa nam mkha' lding gi gdan dang / 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin du skong ba nor bu rin po che'i gdan dang / chags pa'i skyon thams cad spangs pa pad ma'i gdan dang / rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba nyi zla'i gdan thob par gyur cig rin chen du ma las grub seng ge'i khri/ /yid 'ong sna tshogs gos kyis bkab pa 'di/ /spros bral gsung rab mchog la phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rdo rje 'i gdan la bzhugs par shog

/oṃ badzra ā sa na ya āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu bzhin rab bkra yang / /gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i/ /gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyangs phyir 'bul/ /bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ badzra wasatra ye āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zung 'jug dam chos 'dzin pa kun bral yang / /thabs dang shes rab rjes su 'grol gyur pa'i/ /nyi zla lta bu'i rten 'brel dgab bya ba/ /phul bas skye bos zung 'jug rtogs par shog /oṃ badzra pradzñā u pa ya ā dā ya āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ spros pa du ma rab tu rgyas gyur kyang / /ye shes chen por ro gcig gyur pa ltar/ /glegs bam gcig gyur yo byad phul ba yis/ /'gro bas ye shes chen po rtogs par shog /oṃ badzra pusta ka bandha āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ de nas sbyin sreg mnga' dbul byed na/ gnas de'am gzhan thag nye ba zhig tu thabs stegs la bri ba'am/ yang na lcags slang sogs snod mi thub pa la rgyas pa'i thab gru bzhi ser po'i spyir kha khyer gru bzhi/ de'i phyir mu ran gru bzhir rin chen phreng ba/ de'i phyir stegs bu gru bzhi chag can gyi gra bzhir zla phyed rdo rje phyed pa rtse nang bstan/ thab kyi dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum rtse rang la bstan pa'i nang tshom bu'am/ yang na nyi gdan la phur bu rtse rang la bstan pa/ thab kyi shar lhor tshom bu'am bgrang phreng bri/ me yol gangs ri dang chu ris baṃ yig gis mtshan pa bcas kyi thab de'i kha khyer la 'bras bu can gyi shing ngam/ yang na srog chags med pa'i lci ba gtsang ma gru bzhir brtsigs pa'i g.yon rang gi g.yas nas yam shing mar til zas mchog dang / so ba 'bras nas gro sran ma/ dur wa ku sha'i bsreg rdzas dang / thab kyi g.yas rang gi g.yon nas chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ me lha'i zlum gtor/ thab nang shar lhor ting lo/ spor lde/ ku sha brgyad/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril bar dgang blugs kha sbyor/

nang mchod/ ḍā ma ru/ dung chos/ dri bzang chu/ 'thor g.yab/ ku sha gzhan yang / rnga rol dung sogs dang / rten drung snod bzang 'bru'i gang bar spos ring btsugs pa bzhag la slob dpon kha byang du phyogs shing / gzhan rnams gral gang 'os bcas/ gong gi bsangs chur rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas 'thor tshul byas la/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ tas bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ shaṃ las byung ba'i dung phor nang / /hūm̐ las byung ba'i bsang chu yi/ /thab yo'i 'bags dang ma dag kun/ /sel ba'i nus mthu dang ldan gyur/ /zhes dang / 'khyil sngags nyer gcig sogs ci 'grub bzlas la/ thab yo la rdo rje dang bcas pa'i 'thor yab kyis gtor nas bsangs sbyangs sngags gong bzhin/ āḥlas bandha 'bar ba'i nang / /hūm̐ las mchod yon zhabs bsil dang / /nyer spyod lnga dang de bzhin du/ /rol mo la sogs mchod rdzas dang / /bsreg rdzas rgyas las sgrub nus gyur/ /oṃ badzra a ra li nas/ bi pu ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa bar dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ yam shing / oṃ shri swāhā/ mar/ oṃ dzriṃ swāhā/ 'bru/ oṃ oṃ swāhās rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhās rdzas thams cad sbyangs/ thab bsangs sbyangs nas mchod pa dang lhan cig song bas bskyed chog ni/ paṃ pad raṃ nyir hūm̐ las byung / /rgyas thab ser po gru bzhi pa/ /rgyar ni khru do dpangs su ni/ /khru gang kha khyer mu ran la/ /rin chen phreng bskor phyi rol gyi/ /stegs bu khru bzhi'i grwa bzhi ru/ /zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan nang du/ /raṃ las bgrang phreng raṃ mtshan las/ /me lha dmar po gser 'od can/ /ra skyes la zhon zhal gcig pa/ /phyag g.yas bgrang phreng g.yon spyi blugs/ /lto che ral thod sma ra can/ /drang srong tshogs bskor gnas gsum du/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ mtshan bdag nyid kyi/ /thugs ka'i 'od kyis shar lho nas/ /me lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs gyur/ /zhes dang / bcom dung bcom rol nyis brdeg len can la/

slob dpon gyis dbyu gu rtse gsum phyag rgya g.yab pa dang rang re'i srin thung gi dbyangs kyis/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/ /thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ /'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ agne ye ma hā te dza sarba ka ma pra sa dha ka ma hā bhu ta de wa ṛ ṣi/ de wī dza satwa/ ma gṛ hi two/ sarba satt+wattha kri twa āḥhūm̐ ti asmi santi he twa bhā wa padma ka ma la ye satwaṃ/ nyis brdeg len can chems rdung rkang dung sum brdeg len can rol bskor 'bebs bcas rnga rol bzhag so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhu ta dzwa la ya sarba duṣṭan bhasmin ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ tri shya ho dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes dam la bzhag oṃ badzra yakṣi ni hūm̐ dzaḥ sogs kyis kun dgug gzhug bya/ thabs kyis spyod pa'i nas/ karma kro dhi shwa ri āḥbar/ ratna kī la ya yab yum gyis dbu brgyan/ ku sha brgyad bsangs sbyangs gong bzhin/ slob dpon gyis thal mo'i bar du bzung / gzhan rnams kyis rnga brdung 'dur mas/ hūm̐ las dag byed ku sha ljang / /rtswa rtse ma nyams thab yo yi/ /'bags dang ma dag sel ba yi/ /nus mthu phun tshogs dang ldan gyur/ /gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa/ shar phyogs sgo srung ma'i dbyangs rol bcas/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin/ /rol mo rdzogs nas chems rdung sgang dung sbugs la/ 'dis bdag cag gi bgegs dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs zhi zhing las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/

oṃ badzra satwa āḥ sngags 'di lan brgyad brjod/ las rdor gyis thab kyi shar sogs/ phyogs dang / shar lho sogs mtshams bzhir rtse mo g.yas bskor du bkram nas gsum brdeg len can rnga rol bzhag spor lde sbar ba slob dpon gyis thal mos bzung zhing / thab la gru bzhi g.yas bskor lan gsum dang bstun/ kī la ya/ brjod mthar/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ gyis thab nang ting lo 'bar ba rtsa skam gtsang ma gzhan dang bcas pas me sbar/ sngags de nyid dang mar dgang blugs gsum gru bzhi g.yas bskor kyis me gsos/ dgang blugs lag g.yas g.yon khu tshur las mtheb mdzub sbyar ba'i tshigs bar ma bcag pa rin chen khu tshur gyis 'dzin pa 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre yin no/ /me lha'i ljags ni hūm̐ las byung / rdo rje rtse lnga dgang blugs kyi kha la'ang raṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ agna ye swāhā/ oṃ agna dī bya bi shuddhe ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams rigs rgyud dpal 'byor lung rtogs yon tan sogs legs pa'i yon tan thams cad puṣṭi ku ru oṃ/ de 'dra tshar gsum/ rnga brdung / mgon po 'khor dang ma'i mchod dbyangs rol mo bcas/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /me lha 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /legs tshogs rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /ces dang / rol mo/ oṃ agna ye sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa 'og ma rnams 'dur shur gang rung gis/ gtsang zhing༞ lha rdzas༞ zhabs bsil༞ me༞ oṃ agna ye/ pa dyaṃ༞ de bzhin me tog bdug spos mar me dri zhal zas rnams la tshig bsgyur dang / mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i so so'i sngags mthar gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa te/ rol mo la dbyangs gong bzhin rol mo'i mthar chems dung sgang dung gsum brdeg len can dang / slob dpon gyis mtheb srin sbyar ba'i nang mchod phyag rgya/

rnga brdung 'dur shur gang rung gis/ rang byung / shlau ka gcig oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa'i mthar sbraṃ gcig gnyis byas/ gcig gnyis byas/ gcig ces dang / de dang gnyis med ma'i/ dbyangs rol gyis/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍa kis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs/ /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pas bstod/ rnga rol bzhag me pra brtags/ tshag sgra/ dung chen/ me rtag 'phro ba/ thum gyis shi ba/ mdangs med pa sogs ngan pas/ hūm̐ zhes bsangs chu gtor/ gsal zhing / dal la/ ser mdangs can/ du ba sngo skya/ sgra snyan pa rnams shes pas bsang chu 'thor mi dgos/ de nas bsregs rdzas dbul ba ni thog mar yam shing 'bras bu can gyi shing dbul zhing / oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ya swāhā/ zhes bdun gyis phul ba'i mthar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ye/ spel tshig gong bzhin/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la yang de'i rigs pas shes par byas la/ oṃ agna ye swāhā/ zhes pas mar dang / oṃ sarba pā paṃ da hā na badzra ya swāhā/ zhes pas ting lo yungs dkar dang / oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swāhā/ zhes zho dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog dang / oṃ badzra bi dza ye swāhā/ 'bras so ba bcas dang / oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye swāhā/ 'bras dang / oṃ ma hā be ga ye swāhā/ nas dang / oṃ badzra ghasma rī ye swāhā/ gro dang / oṃ ma hā ba la ye swāhā/ sran ma dang / oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ dur ba dang / oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ya swāhā/ ku sha rnams phul ba/ sde tshan re re mthar gong ltar gyis spel tshig sbyar ro/ /der bsangs chu nas me nang du cung zad blugs la/ oṃ prokṣa naṃ añtsa ma naṃ pra titstsha swāhā/ zhes pas bsang gtor dang zhabs bsil phul/ mar blugs gzar gang thab nang du blugs la/ dgang gzar ma reg pa/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/

par bsam/ drug pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ slar me gso ba'i phyir bud shing brtsig pa dang / mchod pa bsreg rdzas rnams kha cung zad la/ 'khyil pa'i sngags dang / oṃ ma hā shu n+yā tā dzñā na badzra swā bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badzra swā bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ sogs kyi me dang thab bsangs sbyangs/ rdo rje khro bos zhe sdang gcod/ /mtshon chen sngon po cher 'bar ba/ /nam mkha'i dkyil du thig le shar/ /srog gi sgo ru shar ba dang / /snying gi dkyil du bsgom par bya/ /hūm̐ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las raṃ yaṃ khaṃ spros pas/ /snod bcud bsreg gtor bkrus skyon dag /e yaṃ baṃ raṃ laṃ raṃ keṃ/ e spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las sa bon de dag spros/ /rten gyi dkyil 'khor nyid gyur te/ /e las nam mkha' yaṃ las rlung / /baṃ chu raṃ me laṃ sa'i dkyil/ /raṃ las khrag mtsho keṃ las ni/ /rus pa'i ri rab steng e las/ /gru gsum mthing nag mu khyud la/ /rdo rje rwa bas bskor dbus su/ /pad nyi zla gdan dbang phyug dang / /u ma bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /rgyu ba'i ting 'dzin hūm̐ gnas las/ /'od 'phros don gnyis mdzad nas kyang / /tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim par gyur/ /zhes dang / kī la ya/ tshar gsum/ gru gsum dbus su khro bo'i rgyal/ /bcom ldan sogs nas yum bskyed pa'i bar sta gon bzhin/ 'di ni bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems sogs rab gnas rten gtso bo'i dbang du btang ba yin la/ rten gtso glegs bam yin na/ rus pa'i ri rab steng e las/ /gru gsum dmar nag zhes/ pad nyi zla gdan chu yi lha/ /pho mo bsnol ba'i zhes/ thim par gyur gyi rjes su/ oṃ padma ki li kī la ya sarba bighnān bhandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang / gru gsum/ sogs/ bcom ldan padma kī la ya sogs/ oṃ padma kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐/ yum chen padma sogs/ mchod rten dang lha khang yin na/ e las kyis rjes su/ gru gsum smug nag

ces dang / pad nyi zla steng lha pho mo/ /bsnol steng rgyu yi hūm̐ gnas las/ /zhes dang / oṃ buddha kī la sogs/ gru gsum sogs/ bcom ldan buddha sogs gzhan 'dra/ oṃ buddha kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐/ yum chen buddhā shwa ri/ sogs gzhan 'dra'o/ /gong ltar bskyed tshar ba dang / rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las/ /'od 'phros rten gtso'i ye shes pa/ /gcig la gnyis mched sangs rgyas dang / /byang sems tshogs bcas spyan drangs gyur/ /zhes dang / bcom dung bcom rol gsum brdeg hūm̐ sgeg cing / sogs nas/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku bar/ dur khrod smug nag dbyangs rol/ e ka dza ṭi gu hya gsang ba'i yum/ /thugs dam rjes dgongs gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /zhes sam/ padma kī la yar bskyed pa ltar nas/ gar dgu'i rol mdzad padma kī la ya/ /padma kro dhi shwa ri gsang ba'i sogs/ buddha kī la yar/ gar dgu'i rol mdzad buddha kī la ya/ buddha kro dhi/ sogs rigs 'gre bas skabs su gang babs kyi tshig rkang gnyis 'dur shur gang rung mthar gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa chems rdung sgang dung / oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sa pa ri wā ra sa ma dzaḥzhes sam/ oṃ padma kī li sogs sam/ oṃ buddha kī li/ sogs bskyed chog gang byas kyis mtshan la/ sa pā ri/ sogs btags pas brjod/ lus rdor gyis rten gtsor phyag gsum 'tshal nas kha ras lag lcibs dar bcas gong gi 'bru/ rengs bu bcas khyer nas slob dpon la phul/ slob dpon gyis rengs bu rtse nas cung zad btogs pas dang / 'bru de nas phran bu thab nang du gtor la/ lhag ma nye 'khor du bzhag sum brdeg len can/ rol skor 'bebs bcas rnga rol bzhag oṃ badzra yakṣi/ nas/ karma kro dhi shwa ri āḥ bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ dgug gzhug gnas gsum byin rlabs dbang bskur rnams byas la/ khro bo rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ zhes brjod/ oṃ badzra kī li sogs sam/ oṃ padma kī li sogs sam/

oṃ buddha kī li/ sogs bskyed chog gang yin gyi sngags tshar gsum sngon 'gro byon zan me lha bzhin slar yang bsreg rdzas mchod rdzas rnams gong bzhin byin rlabs/ rgyas par na/ rdo rje sgeg mo/ sogs phyi mchod/ rang byung nas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shrī ka pā la bandha ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bar/ byang chub nas pra ti gṛhṇa khā hi/ bar/ gdab ka drug yongs rdzogs sam/ yang na dang po rnga rol dbyangs gnyis gang rung yod med bcas rgyun bzhin/ he ru ka yi nas/ badzra yakṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi/ bar la dbyangs byed mi byed kyi dbang gis rol mo sogs rgyun bzhin shes par bya'o/ /de nas bstod dbyangs byed na dgu brdeg len can rgyun bzhin ci byed na gsum brdeg len can/ hūm̐ gru gsum nas/ thugs rje cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /bar dang / bhyoḥ de dang / nas/ mngon sum grub pa'i las mdzod da tshur byon/ bar gyi dbyangs rol rnams byed dam mi byed gang rung rgyun bzhin/ padma kī la ya/ ltar na/ hūm̐ gru gsum dmar nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /mi bzad dpal chen padma kī la ya/ /'dod chags gsung mchog yakṣa he ru ka /ye shes sku mchog nas༞ /dbyings nas 'gyed༞ bar 'dra/ sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs sogs 'dra/ g.yas kyi zhal mdog mthing gar ston pa ni/ /phrin las thams cad lhun gyis grub par ston/ /g.yon gyi zhal mdog dkar la bzhad pa ni/ /skye med chos sku'i rang bzhin nyid du gnas/ /dbus zhal dmar nag dbang drag rol pa che/ /skye 'gro nas/ nas/ sbyor bar 'dra/ padma dmar po phyag na bsnams pa ni/ /chags pa'i rang bzhin 'dod chags rnam par dag /ye shes me nas/ stsol bar 'dra/ bhyoḥ de dang gnyis med sbyor ba'i yum mchog ni/ /padma kro dhi shwa ri gsang ba'i yum/ /gar dbang mkha' las pad rāg gsal 'tsher zhing / /sindu wa ra'i ral pa gcig tu 'khyil/ /khro gnyer/ nas/

zhags kyi bar 'dra/ dmar 'od sku la/ sogs/ pad ma dmar po 'bar ba g.yas na thogs/ /bhandha rtse gsum 'bar ba g.yon na thogs/ /padma kro dhi za byed dpal gyi yum/ /rdo rje me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /chu lha pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /gzer nas/ mngon sum grub pa'i las mdzod da tshur byon/ /bar 'dra/ buddhā ltar na/ hūm̐ gru gsum smug nag ces dang / mi bzad dpal chen buddhā kī la ya/ /gti mug sku mchog yakṣa he ru ka /ye shes nas/ dbyings nas 'gyed/ bar 'dra/ mdog smug nag sogs/ g.yas g.yon zhal mdog dkar dmar ston pa ni/ /skye med chos sku dbang drag phrin las can/ /dbus zhal smug nag phrin las kun rdzogs tshul/ skye 'gro sogs nas/ sbyor bar 'dra/ rang rtags 'khor lo 'bar ba bsnams pa ni/ /srid zhi mnyam nyid rgyun mi chad pa'i rtags/ /ye shes me nas/ stsol bar 'dra/ bhyoḥ de dang / sogs/ buddha kro dhi shwa ri gsang ba'i yum/ /gar dbang klong nas sku mdog mchong smug mdog /dmar nag ral pa'i tshogs rnams gcig tu 'khyil/ /khro gnyer/ nas/ zhags kyi bar 'dra/ smug sku la/ sogs/ rang rtags 'khor lo 'bar ba g.yas na/ sogs 'dra/ buddha shwa ri za byed/ sogs/ lha dbang pho mo bsnol ba'i/ sogs nas/ mngon sum grub pa'i las mdzod da tshur byon/ /bar 'dra bas skabs thob shes par byas mthar gsum brdeg len can rgyas pa chem brdung sgang dung sbraṃ gcig gnyis zhes rnga rol bzhag bsreg rdzas yam shing nas bcu gcig mar nas bcu gcig mngar gsum gyis sbags pa'i 'bras bus gtso bya dgos pas/ kham star/ mnga' ris kham bu/ kha purpa ṇi/ rgya gar star kha/ sog po'i shing thog chi bi kha/ a smra/ rgun 'bru sogs bzang po lhan cig bsres pa/ nas brgya dang brgyad/ til nas bcu gcig zas mchog nas brgya dang brgyad/ so ba nas bcu gcig 'bras nas brgya dang brgyad/ nas gro sran nas bcu gcig dur ba nas brgya dang brgyad/

ku sha nas bcu gcig ste thams cad/ kī la ya/ 'ba' zhig gis 'bul mtshams rnams su spel tshig gong bzhin thab khung gi me la mañdza'i steng du/ tshon dkar po'am ser pos byugs pa'i snod bzhag la/ de'i nang du 'bras dang sbrang rtsi dang / ka ra bsres pa'i 'o ma blugs la/ kī la ya sogs/ sngags gang yin gong gi rigs 'gres shes pas de nyid stong sogs bzlas pas 'o thug bsgrub pa las/ khol thag chod pa dang / na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga ṇa khaṃ swāhā/ zhes dang / zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog pa/ /legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /oṃ di bye anna sa ma dhi dhya na pri ṇa ye swāhā/ zhes dang / dgang blugs kyis thab nang du brgya dang brgyad/ kī li ya/ bzla zhing phul bas spel tshig sbyar/ lhag ma dpon slob rnams nas longs spyod/ gang ba'i sbyin sreg gong gi byon zan lugs/ sgeg phreng sogs kyis phyi mchod/ rang byung sogs nang mchod bum bskyed lugs/ dril gsil gdangs med kyis/ sgeg cing nas/ e ka dza ṭi gu hye gsang ba'i yum/ /bar bsnyen sgrub gsal byed bzhin/ dpal chen yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces sam/ sgeg cing / sogs 'dra/ gar dgus rol mdzad padma kī la ya/ /padma kro dhi shwa ri gsang ba'i yum/ /sogs sam/ gar dgus rol mdzad buddha ki la ya/ /buddha kro dhi/ sogs rigs 'gre bas skabs bstun bya/ ye shes lnga ldan/ sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum dang / ma 'byor ba dang / sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ las rdor gyis slob dpon la phyag gsum btsal/ spyan 'dren gyis spos la thab nas me gsos/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /sogs kyis thab kyi ye shes pa/ rten gtso'i thugs kar gshegs/

slob dpon gyis spel 'bru las rdor la gtod/ las rdor gyi kha ras lag lcib bcas khyer nas rten drung du bzhag la 'bru de nas cung zad gtor la/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thal ba blangs la dpral bar reg go /thab khung du mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar la reg pa dang bcas pas blug la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ zhes brjod la/ mi lha zhal gcig phyag gnyis dwangs shing thogs pa med pa'i sku can du gyur/ par bsam/ de nas bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams so so'i spel tshig dang bcas pa bdun re phul/ slar yang mar gyis gang ba'i sbyin sreg lan bdun phul la/ mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ gnyis pa gtor ma btang ba ni/ me lha 'khor bcas la gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ gtor snod rin chen las grub nang / /gtor ma 'dod yon lnga yi dngos/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du/ /mngon par byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ /zhes dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro muḥ btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra/ sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi mchod dang / nang mchod gong bzhin dang / bstod pa ni/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs shlauka gcig gis bstod/ gsum pa 'dod don zhu ba ni/ rnga brdungs/ gang thugs ma'i bu dbyangs kyis 'jig rten/ sogs gong bzhin rol mo gsum brdeg len can 'dur shur gang rung gis/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis skur sprul pa/ /rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs bsregs pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyis sprul pa'i theg pa chibs/ /rig sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin/

/bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan ghundhe bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsis yongs la bsil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje can/ /de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /drang srong chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar gyis 'dod don gsol ba'o/ /bzhi pa gshegs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ prokṣa nāṃ añtsa ma naṃ pā dyaṃ pra tī tstsha swāhā/ bsangs gtor dang zhabs bsil phul/ bdag gis don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyis gshegs/ /ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ /oṃ agna ye ya hi gatstsha/ zhes dang / dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed de/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ par bsam mo/ /yig brgya lan gsum brjod la nang du log sbyin sreg ma 'grub na/ tsā ru'i bza' ba sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i zas sna bcas bshams la las bum gyis chus sbyangs/ gong bzhin/ na maḥ nas/ pra ṇa ne swāhā/ bar gyis phul/ rten gyis gtso bo la gzungs thag btags pa dpon slob kun gyis bzung la rten la nas gtor zhing / oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzre swāhā/ oṃ hrī ཿhūm̐ bhruṃ khaṃ badzri bhā wa tri ḍha tiṣṭha bhu khaṃ swāhā/ zhes pa nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / mthar dril gsil rol chen me tog gtor nas zhwa gyon/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad gang shes brjod/ mthar yang rol chen sogs gong bzhin/ mchod bstod spyan dbye'i rjes su bshad pa bzhin byas nas gtor bsngo nas/ gtor rdzong / rdor glu/ bkra shis smon lam rdzogs bar/ nyin gong ma rnams la tshogs sogs nas/ bkra shis rdzogs khar sgrub mchod bzhin/ nyin rjes mar chos skyong bsgo ba rang re'i gtor bsngo sbags sgrub bzhin la phrin bcol rdzogs/

bdag gis rab tu gnas pa legs par byas pa'i rten 'di la/ srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams kyis bsrung ba dang / skyob par gyis shig ces bsgo/ chos skyong de nus pa bskyed pa'i phyir rdo rje go cha'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badzra rakṣa haṃ/ zhes brjod pas rdo rje'i go bkon nas nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa bya/ de nas bdag gi bka' las mi 'da' bar bya ba'i phyir rdo rje thogs la mgo bor bzhag pa'i tshul bya zhing dam la bzhag par bsam la/ ngag tu/ rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ /gal te dam las 'das gyur na/ /'jig gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /oṃ ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdag dang yon bdag 'khor dang bcas la bsrung ba dang / bsam pa thams cad 'grub pa dang / rten 'di la mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod cig tshogs lhag ma spyi bstab bstan skyong mjug chog ni/ ādya nutpanna twa/ bar yon bdag bsgo ba la/ las sngags bsgyur ba dang / khyed rang rnams skad cig gis rdo rje gzhon nu/ nas/ mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ bar gong dbang gi skabs bzhin/ gzhan 'don cha tshang ma rab gnas dkyus 'gre/ mchod pa byin brlabs/ sgeg phreng / sogs gong sbyin bsreg rjes bzhin bstod pa mnga' 'bul gyi mgo bzhin la bla ma'i bstod pa man bya/ bzang spyod yan lag bdun pa sngon 'gro'i bsngo ba/ dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas/ sogs sgrub mchod mjug sor bzhag zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byed na bsnyen pa'i skabs bzhin la spel tshig bdag dang yon bdag gis gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi byur dang skal ba ngan pa bkra mi shis pa dang / cho ga lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shantiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes sbyar bcu cha'i grangs 'dzin mi dgos/ 'das pa'i me lha'i sreg rdzas gzhan bcu gcig til brgya rtsa 'bul/
